title: Critique: self-models alone do not produce problem intuitions

statements.text: An internal model of one’s own states does not by itself yield the sense of a hard problem: people model their own beliefs without such intuitions. An account built on introspective models, as AST is, owes an explanation of why the phenomenal case differs.

sources.quote: I have occasionally heard it suggested that internal self-models will inevitably produce problem intuitions, but this seems clearly false.
Introspective models are especially central in Graziano’s (2013) ‘attention schema’ theory of consciousness
